privacy.intro: This template describes how {company} handles information on this website. Review it against actual business practices before launch.
privacy.collection.title: Information you provide
privacy.collection.text: The inquiry form collects your name, email, company, country, phone or WhatsApp, WeChat ID, product interests, quantities, message and sample preference. We also receive your product list, page language, source page, campaign parameters and submission time.
privacy.use.title: How we use inquiry details
privacy.use.text: We use the information you submit only to reply to your inquiry and discuss the products, samples and quotation you requested. We do not use your inquiry details for advertising analytics.
privacy.services.title: Services used by this website
privacy.services.text: Cloudflare hosts and protects the website. Cloudflare Turnstile checks form requests to help prevent spam. Resend delivers inquiry emails. If configured and accepted, Google Analytics measures website use. These providers process information needed for their services under their own policies; processing locations may differ from your location.
privacy.storage.title: Cookies and browser storage
privacy.storage.text: Your inquiry list and optional quantities are saved in this browser so you can review several products together. Your Cookie choice is also stored locally. Google Analytics is not loaded before you accept. If storage is unavailable, analytics remain off. The inquiry list is cleared after a successful submission; you can also clear it yourself.
privacy.choice.title: Change your choice
privacy.choice.text: You can accept or reject optional analytics, then change your choice using Cookie settings in the footer. Rejecting does not prevent browsing products or sending an inquiry. Browser settings also let you remove stored data.
privacy.retention.title: Access and corrections
privacy.retention.text: Contact us if you need to correct or request deletion of information you submitted. Before launch, the operator should confirm retention practices and any requirements that apply to its business.

privacy.contact.text: For questions about your information, contact {company} at {email}.
